description: This file contains unit tests for ADO.NET Grain Directory implementations against different SQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) using the Orleans testing framework. It defines test classes for each database type and a base class with setup and configuration logic for the test cluster.

classes.name: SqlServerAdoNetGrainDirectoryClusterTests
classes.description: Test class for ADO.NET Grain Directory against SQL Server.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetGrainDirectoryClusterTests
classes.description: Test class for ADO.NET Grain Directory against PostgreSQL.

classes.name: MySqlAdoNetGrainDirectoryClusterTests
classes.description: Test class for ADO.NET Grain Directory against MySQL.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectoryClusterTests
classes.description: Abstract base class providing setup and configuration for ADO.NET Grain Directory tests across different relational databases.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Inner class implementing ISiloConfigurator to configure silo builder with ADO.NET Grain Directory options.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the test class with a specific database invariant.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous setup method that initializes the relational storage testing environment and performs base class initialization.
